description: Do you want to join an innovative service delivering high-quality interventions in the community to people with a range of mental health problems? If the answer is yes, and you meet the essential criteria, then please apply for this post. We are looking for an experienced, skilled, positive-minded, trustworthy, hardworking, and enthusiastic Administrator with a flexible approach to provide administrative support to the clinical team, ensuring a first-class service is delivered to our service users. Working hours of the posts: X1 37.5 hours. Monday to Friday (09:00 17:00 30 minutes lunch) Working Base: Valley Road Academy, 2 Corporation Rd, Hendon, Sunderland SR2 8PL X1 15 hours. Working within core hours Monday to Friday (09:00 17:00 30 minutes lunch) Working base: Wessington Primary School, Lanercost, Washington NE38 7PY X1 37.5 hours Monday to Friday (09:00 17:00 30 minutes lunch) Working Base: Grassbanks Health Centre NE10 8DX X1 30 hours Monday to Thursday (09:00 17:00 30 minutes lunch) Working Base : Cleadon Park Primary Care Centre X1 16 hours Monday and Tuesday (09:00 17:00 30 minutes lunch) Working Base: Cleadon Park Primary Care Centre Please note the post holder will be required to travel to other sites to cover shortfalls within the division should the need occur, therefore access to a car is preferred. The service receives referrals from a range of sources including external agencies such as GPs, internal colleagues within the trust, and self-referrals from clients wishing to access the service. Key Tasks within role: To manage the scheduling of new/review patients in line with national standards highlighting any capacity issues to the Admin Lead, Clinical Team Manager as needed. To manage the Clinician diary on a day-to-day basis, making changes to the profiling of slots as requested by clinicians. To provide supervision to junior staff as and when needed. To ensure that all mandatory information systems are updated within Iaptus. To oversee cancellation and rescheduling of appointment requests. To coordinate the admin inbox ensuring colleague and patient communications are responded to promptly. Minute taking at internal and external meetings. To process any incoming/outgoing mail. To be responsible for the management of petty cash. To be responsible for the ordering of stationary. To provide support to the wider Mental Health Admin Teams in times of shortfalls. The post holder should be organised, empathetic, and adaptable to change. The post holder may occasionally be exposed to upsetting and distressing calls, therefore an element of resilience is needed, however full training is provided internally. PLEASE REFER TO THE ATTACHED JOB DESCRIPTION FOR FULL DUTIES OF THE ROLE. To be the first point of contact for service users and professionals contacting the Service to make a referral via the telephone, showing empathy and understanding. Completing the referral form over the telephone, where required, ensuring patient information is inputted into the Iaptus System in real time efficiently and effectively. To liaise with the Clinical Team as referrals are received to ensure they are triaged in a timely manner. To coordinate the scheduling processes on a day to day basis including overseeing any cancellation or rescheduling of appointments. Diary management. To provide reception cover meeting and greeting service users into the department. Care Pathway management- ensuring patients are moved to the appropriate stage in within the care pathway as needed. To ensure that appropriate procedures and Trust Policies are adhered to at all times and that national standards and RTT performance targets are met. To comply with the Trusts vision, values and behavioural compact. Please note the Trust are not able to offer Skilled Worker Sponsorship for this role as it does not meet the UKVI threshold requirements. Applicants are requested to consider this when making their applic ation. Please visit Gov.UK for further information.
